description: We are a passionate, multidisciplinary team building GlacierWatch for NASA Space Apps to monitor GLOFs in Gilgit-Baltistan using NASA POWER and Sentinel-2 data. Our platform features automated risk scoring, real-time telemetry, and Urdu emergency alerts. We are currently looking for enthusiastic teammates skilled in UI/UX design, frontend development (JS/CSS), or geospatial data analysis to help us build a life-saving solution.
